title: Writer Assistant Core review UI/API planning and owner-action workflow contract
goal: Publish the planning and contract parent that decides whether and how the project-local review queue storage and owner action record validation produced by the completed PHASE8-IMPL-012 review queue storage helper should be exposed through a read-only review queue API, an owner-action command API, and a frontend review UI, without implementing any backend routes, frontend screens, owner action execution, apply-promotion, or memory/canon mutation, and without implementing review UI/API, routes, or owner action execution in T001.
why_now: PHASE8-IMPL-012 is complete through T007 and delivered backend/story_knowledge/review_queue_storage.py (a pure project-local candidate-linked review-workflow-only queue storage helper), review queue storage contract tests, project-local queue write/read/list, a derived/rebuildable index, and owner action record shape validation only, with no review UI/API, no backend routes, no frontend UI, no owner action execution, no apply-promotion, no memory/canon mutation, and no runtime extraction. The review queue is now storable, listable, and indexable, but nothing exposes it to an owner yet. The next risk is accidental backend review routes, owner action execution, review UI scope creep, or apply-promotion without an explicit contract.
planning_questions: Whether backend review routes are needed before frontend review UI.
What a read-only review queue API contract would expose without becoming approval or canon truth.
What an owner-action command API contract would accept and reject without apply-promotion.
How a review UI should display evidence/provenance/uncertainty and non-approval status without implying canon.
How the owner action workflow stays separate from apply-promotion.

include: Read-only review queue API contract decision.
Review API/UI contract tests if authorized by prior children.
Review API/UI safety regression or conditional hardening decision.
exclude: Backend review routes or API endpoints.
Real BookNLP/spaCy install, run, or import.
Generated prose, rewriting, continuation, imitation, polish, improvement, or expansion.
Model calls, Ollama calls, Story Check calls, demos, or app server runs.
Training data, JSONL records, dataset manifests, or model artifacts.

context_tools_policy: No CCE, Graphify, Repomix, AI Context, MCP tools, or LeanCTX were authorized or run for T001, T002, or T003.
external_tool_policy: No external tools were installed, cloned, fetched, pulled, executed, imported, copied, or vendored in T001, T002, or T003.
candidate_record_policy: Candidate records remain candidate-only and review-pending and never become canon, memory, owner decisions, or promotion by default. This parent does not modify candidate schema/record/storage/persistence/list/index modules.
review_queue_policy: Review queue entries are workflow support only, not approval, canon, memory, storyform truth, owner decisions, generated prose, or apply-promotion. T001 does not implement review UI/API, routes, owner action execution, or persistence beyond the inherited PHASE8-IMPL-012 helper.
review_api_policy: Whether and how the review queue is exposed through a read-only review queue API and whether backend routes are needed before UI is decided in later children before any route exists. Any future review queue API must be read-only, review-workflow-only, evidence/provenance-backed, and must not expose approval/canon/promotion or perform apply-promotion. T001 does not implement a review API.
owner_action_api_policy: Owner-action command API accepted/rejected commands, states, fail-closed behavior, and audit affirmations are decided in later children. Owner actions are not apply-promotion and owner action execution remains deferred. T001 does not implement an owner action API.
review_ui_policy: Review UI display/interaction boundaries are decided in later children. Any future review UI must display evidence/provenance/uncertainty and non-approval status, must show no-promotion warnings, and must not imply canon. T001 does not implement review UI.
owner_review_policy: Owner review is mandatory before queue entries or candidate records can become approved truth.
apply_promotion_policy: Apply-promotion remains unimplemented and is not authorized by this parent.
memory_canon_policy: No memory/canon mutation is authorized by this parent.
no_runtime_extraction_policy: No real BookNLP/spaCy runtime, extraction tool execution, backend extraction route, frontend extraction UI, or package/dependency change is authorized by T001.
no_generated_prose_policy: No generated prose, rewrite, continuation, imitation, polish, improvement, or expansion is authorized by this parent.
